# DegenKit

> DegenKit (https://degenkit.app) is a no-code, non-custodial token launcher. Create a token on Solana, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base, Robinhood Chain or Elysium by filling one form and signing one transaction from your own wallet. DegenKit never holds keys or funds.

## Launch a token
- [Choose a network](https://degenkit.app/launch/): network selector
- [Solana](https://degenkit.app/launch/solana/): SPL tokens, mint/freeze authority revoked and metadata locked at creation; tools: Authorities, Update Metadata, Burn, Airdrop, Multisender, Scanner, Swap
- [Ethereum](https://degenkit.app/launch/ethereum/): fixed-supply ERC-20 and tax tokens
- [BNB Chain](https://degenkit.app/launch/bnb/): BEP-20 and tax tokens
- [Base](https://degenkit.app/launch/base/): ERC-20 and tax tokens
- [Elysium](https://degenkit.app/launch/elysium/): ERC-20 and tax tokens on Kinetiq's Hyperliquid Layer 2
- [Robinhood Chain](https://degenkit.app/launch/robinhood/): fixed-supply and tax tokens

## Free tools
- [Token approval checker](https://degenkit.app/tools/token-approval-checker/): find and revoke ERC-20 approvals on Ethereum, Robinhood Chain, Base, BNB Chain and Elysium
- [Robinhood Chain RPC](https://degenkit.app/tools/robinhood-chain-rpc/): RPC URLs, chain ID 4663, live status, add to wallet
